Large.$description: Corner radius for large, content-light UI elements. If not absolutely sure, use the Medium corner radius.

Medium.$description: Default corner radius. Used in buttons, cards, input fields and pretty much everything that has rounded corners.

Small.$description: Used in smaller elements, less than 16x16px. If not absolutely sure, use the Medium corner radius.

Main.$description: Default padding for pages and individual cards

10px.$description: Spacing for exceptional cases. Avoid if possible.

2px.$description: Extremely small spacing. Avoid if possible.

4px.$description:
Base unit.
Use as a small spacing, e.g. between a label and an input field.

8px.$description: Use a spacing or padding within low-level components e.g. between a checkbox and a label.

Large.$description: Large spacing between cards or between screen elements like cards, headers, and page level button groups.

Main.$description: Main spacing between the items in one line (input fields, set of buttons, etc.) and between lines inside a card.

Small.$description: Spacing within low-level components e.g. between a checkbox and a label.

Tiny.$description: Spacing between a label and a field, padding inside a menu item

XLarge.$description: Spacing between large groups of content, e.g., two independent upload sections, wide columns of text, etc.
